subject: error in doc sec 5.3 on multidimensional array variable I/O

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: error in doc sec 5.3 on multidimensional array variable I/O
parts:
A user pointed out in an e-mail message:

> ... In section "5.3. Array
> Variables", the example is given that:
>
> y <- structure(c(1,2,3,4,5,6), .Dim = c(2,3))
>
> results in the following STAN matrix:
>
> y[1,1] = 1 *y[2,1]* = 3*y[3,1]* = 5
> y[2,1] = 2 y[2,2] = 4 *y[3,2]* = 6
>
> Shouldn't this be:
>
> [1] [2] [3]
> [1] 1 3 5
> [2] 2 4 6

Yes, it should be --- 2 rows and 3 columns read
in column-major order following the R convention.
I just fixed the manual for the next release.

Column-major order's very "backwards" to a poor computer
scientist like me.

> Also, a small 3-dimensional example would probably further clarify the format.

Indeed. I just added one.

- Bob
